text: Area residents have raised concerns regarding the intersection of Dufferin Street (west side) and the public lane bounded Armstrong Avenue, Millicent Street and Dufferin Street. The issue is that motorists, cyclists and pedestrians have difficulty seeing northbound and southbound traffic as they exit the public lane to Dufferin Street. Residents inform me of close calls and have asked that a '9' metre 'no parking' rule be introduced on both sides of the public lane. Traffic Operations staff have reviewed this matter and support this change.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on the west side of Dufferin Street, between a point 35 metres north of Armstrong Avenue and a point 25 metres further north.
